verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Factory publishes an llms.txt index at docs.factory.ai/llms.txt, describing itself as documentation for an agent-native platform. Several doc pages are also served as raw Markdown (.md URLs), which suits agent consumption. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on pointing agents at llms.txt or the Markdown docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using them effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
